title: geum aleppicum f. glabricaule
intro: Geum aleppicum f. glabricaule, commonly known as Smooth Avens, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits like anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geum aleppicum f. glabricaule include its use as a diuretic and expectorant, helping to reduce fluid retention and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
